metadata.author: Mathew Smith
metadata.description: Touch-friendly video wall layout and feed assignment editor for WinCC Unified.

ApplyLayout.description: Accept the current layout as the reset baseline and clear the unsaved-changes flag.

ResetChanges.description: Restore the last applied or externally supplied layout.

ClearWall.description: Remove every feed assignment after operator confirmation.

SelectCell.description: Select a wall cell by screen ID, for example R1C1. Pass an empty string to clear the selection.

MergeSelected.description: Merge a rectangular area from the selected top-left cell.

SplitSelected.description: Split the selected merged area back into individual cells.

LayoutChanged.description: Fired with a JSON payload whenever the current layout changes or is applied.

CellSelected.description: Fired with a JSON payload when the selected wall cell changes.

FeedAssigned.description: Fired with a JSON payload after a feed is assigned or replaces another feed.

FeedRemoved.description: Fired with a JSON payload after a feed assignment is removed.

CellsMerged.description: Fired with a JSON payload after physical wall cells are merged into one display area.

CellsSplit.description: Fired with a JSON payload after a merged display area is split.

ConfigurationError.description: Fired with a JSON payload when supplied configuration cannot be accepted completely.

Rows.description: Number of display rows. Valid range is 1 to 8.

Columns.description: Number of display columns. Valid range is 1 to 12; total cells cannot exceed 64.

DisplayGap.description: Gap between display cells in pixels, from 0 to 40.

AvailableFeedsJson.description: JSON array of available video feed definitions.

LayoutJson.description: Complete versioned video wall layout JSON. Updated after operator changes.

AllowDuplicateFeeds.description: Allow one feed to be assigned to more than one cell.

SelectedCell.description: Selected screen ID, for example R1C1, or an empty string.

StatusText.description: Latest status or configuration error message.

HasUnsavedChanges.description: True when the current layout differs from the applied or externally supplied baseline.

BackgroundColor.description: Control background colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.

CellColor.description: Unassigned cell colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.

SelectedCellColor.description: Selected cell accent colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.

AssignedCellColor.description: Assigned cell colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.

TextColor.description: Primary control text colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.
